description: List the indexes the query optimizer asked for on the tables of a library, from the IBM i index advisor (QSYS2.SYSIXADV). Rows with the same table, key columns, and index type are merged into one, with counts summed and reason codes described. Sorted by mti_used, then times_advised: advice where the optimizer kept building and reusing a maintained temporary index (MTI) is the strongest signal. key_columns are in CREATE INDEX order and can end in DESC. last_advised and since are in the system's local time. This tool only reads the advice; it does not create indexes.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Capped by QUERY_MAX_LIMIT.

schema.description: Schema (library) whose tables to read advice for. Uses the system's default schema if not provided.

since.description: Only advice last given on or after this date or timestamp, in the IBM i system's local time with no time zone. Example: "2026-01-31" or "2026-01-31 08:00:00"

table.description: Table name. Omit for every table in the library.

name: index_advice

cause.description: Why the statement failed. &1-style placeholders stand for values in error.

recovery.description: What to change before trying again

sqlcode.description: SQLCODE of the failed statement, such as -204

title: Index Advice
